How names and logos are chosen

fields.options: Themes: one Company Theme per company (accent, colours and logos for Bright and Dark mode). Logo: the Company Theme's Bright / Dark logo, else the Company's own Company Logo, else the fallback logo below. Mode: Bright by default; each person switches with the toggle on the login page (saved in their browser). Company: logged-in users see their own company (from their Employee record) in the desk, website and portal; the login page and visitors who are not logged in see the Login & Website Company.
